title: Short Stirling R9245
memorial_details: Plaque situated where the aircraft first hit earthworks.
inscription: 75 (NZ) SQUADRON RAF/ ON THE NIGHT OF THE 16TH DECEMBER 1942/ STIRLING R9245 AA-N TAKING OFF IN DIFFICULT/ CONDITIONS, WAS CAUGHT BY A STRONG CROSS/ WIND CAUSING IT TO STRIKE THIS EARTHWORK/ WITH THE LOSS OF THE ENTIRE CREW./ IT IS TO THESE YOUNG MEN WHO GAVE THEIR/LIVES IN THE DEFENCE OF THIS COUNTRY THAT/ THIS MEMORIAL IS DEDICATED./ (…) AKE AKE KIA KAHA
